items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: A fellow who rode up the Lazy River with Hoagy Carmichael.

ctx.x: Yeah. Gene Meyer. Some of those are, I believe Ray Benitez may be on some of them, too. Anyway, they're marvelous records. And once again, some of those have been reissued. Let's have a jubilee with Sidney Ayrton on clarinet. A fellow who rode up the Lazy River with Hoagy Carmichael. A forgotten figure today to most people, but one of the great New Orleans clarinet players. Okay, with that, let's go to the next line. Good morning. You're on with Dick Allen and Johnny Wiggs.

Good morning. I heard Tom Brown's name mentioned, and I recall when I was a boy, and that goes back in the 20s, he operated a music supply store on a magazine near Jackson Avenue. He and his wife, do you recall that? Yeah, I remember.
